prompts.title: Je me présente
prompts.prompt: Tu arrives dans un nouveau club d'anglais. Écris une petite présentation de toi : ton prénom, ton âge, ta ville, ta couleur préférée et une personne de ta famille.

require.label: Utilise le présent (I am, I have, my… is) au moins 3 fois
Cite au moins une couleur
Relie tes idées avec and ou but

prompts.model: Hello! My name is Zoé and I'm eleven years old. I'm from Gatineau. My favourite colour is green. I have a green bag and a green pencil case! I have a brother, Félix. He is eight and he is very funny. Nice to meet you!

prompts.title: Mon sac d'école
prompts.prompt: Ton correspondant de Vancouver veut savoir ce qu'il y a dans ton sac d'école. Écris-lui un petit message : au moins 4 objets avec leur couleur (a red pen, an orange eraser…). Attention : a devant une consonne, an devant une voyelle !

require.label: Utilise a ET an (a red pen, an orange eraser)
Au moins 3 couleurs différentes
Utilise le présent (It's…, I have…) au moins 2 fois

prompts.model: Hi Noah! This is my school bag. It's blue and it's very big. In my bag, I have a red pen, a yellow pencil and an orange eraser. I have a green ruler, too. I have a book and an English notebook. My pencil case is purple. Bye! Léa

prompts.title: Voici ma famille
prompts.prompt: Tu montres une photo de famille à un ami. Présente au moins 3 personnes (This is my…) et donne un petit détail sur chacune : son prénom, son âge ou ce qu'elle est.

require.label: Au moins 3 membres de la famille (mom, brother, aunt…)
Utilise This is my… pour présenter
Utilise le présent (is, are, have) au moins 4 fois

prompts.model: This is a photo of my family. This is my mom, Ana. She is a doctor. This is my dad, Karim. He is very tall! This is my sister, Maya. She is twelve and she is funny. And this is my baby brother. He is one. I love my family!

prompts.title: Nouveau collègue
prompts.prompt: Tu commences un nouveau travail dans un bureau à Ottawa. Écris un court courriel à ton équipe pour te présenter : ton nom, ta ville, ta famille, et pose une question à tes collègues.

require.label: Utilise le présent (I am, I have, I live…) au moins 4 fois
Pose au moins une question
Une formule de politesse (Hello, Nice to meet you, Thank you…)

prompts.model:
Hello everyone!
My name is Samuel Martin. I'm your new colleague. I'm from Montreal, but now I live in Ottawa. I have a wife and two children, a boy and a girl. They are seven and ten. I'm very happy to be here! What are your names? Nice to meet you all.
Samuel

prompts.title: Épelle-moi ça !
prompts.prompt: Au téléphone, ton ami ne comprend ni ton prénom ni le nom de ton animal. Écris-lui un message où tu épelles les deux noms lettre par lettre (C-H-L-O-É) et où tu dis quel animal tu as (a dog, an owl…).

require.label: Utilise le verbe spell (How do you spell…?)
Utilise a, an et the
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model: Hi Ethan! My name is Chloé. How do you spell it? C-H-L-O-E, with an accent on the E. I have a pet. It's a rabbit. The rabbit is white and grey. The name of my rabbit is Pistache: P-I-S-T-A-C-H-E. It's a funny name! Bye!

prompts.title: Mon bureau
prompts.prompt: Décris ton bureau (à la maison, à l'école ou au travail) : les objets, leur couleur et combien il y en a (two black chairs…). Attention : l'adjectif ne prend jamais de -s en anglais !

require.label: Au moins 2 nombres écrits en lettres (two, three…)
Au moins 3 couleurs différentes
Utilise le présent (It's…, I have…) au moins 3 fois

prompts.model: This is my desk at home. It's a big white desk. On my desk, I have a black computer, two blue pens and a green plant. I have three yellow notebooks, too. My chair is grey. It's old, but it's nice. Oh, and I have a red cup. It's my coffee cup!

prompts.title: Salut, ça va ?
prompts.prompt: Ton ami est malade et reste à la maison. Écris-lui un petit message : salue-le, demande-lui comment il va, donne de tes nouvelles et dis au revoir gentiment.

require.label: Pose au moins 2 questions
Au moins 2 mots de politesse (hi, thank you, bye…)
Utilise le présent (I'm, it's, you are…) au moins 3 fois

prompts.model: Hi Malik! How are you? Are you OK now? I'm fine, thank you. I'm at school. My teacher is nice, but the class is boring without you! I have your book. It's in my bag. See you soon, my friend. Bye! Liam

prompts.title: Inscription au hockey
prompts.prompt: Tu inscris ton enfant à un club de hockey à Gatineau. Écris un court courriel à l'entraîneur : le nom et l'âge de ton enfant, l'équipement que vous avez (a helmet, a stick…), et pose une question.

require.label: Donne un âge en lettres (nine, ten…)
Pose au moins une question
Utilise le présent (He is, We have…) au moins 3 fois

prompts.model:
Hello Mr. Tremblay,
My name is Sofia Costa. This is an email for my son, Jaden. He is nine years old. He is a good skater! We have a red helmet and a black hockey stick. What day is the hockey class? Thank you very much. Have a nice day!
Sofia Costa

prompts.title: Mon animal
prompts.prompt: Décris ton animal (vrai ou imaginaire) : son espèce, sa taille, sa couleur, son corps (he has big ears…) et son caractère (lazy, happy, always hungry…).

require.label: Utilise has / have pour décrire le corps
Utilise le présent (is, has…) au moins 4 fois
Au moins 3 adjectifs différents

prompts.model: My dog is called Biscuit. He is small and brown. He has big ears, short legs and a long tail. His eyes are black. He is always hungry! He isn't scared of cats, but he is scared of the vacuum. When I'm sad, he is happy to sit with me. He is my best friend.

prompts.title: Camping catastrophe
prompts.prompt: Tu es en camping et rien ne va. Écris un message drôle à un ami : dis comment tu te sens (I'm cold, I'm hungry… et surtout pas « I have cold » !) et comment vont les autres. Utilise aussi des négations (isn't, aren't).

require.label: Au moins 3 sentiments ou sensations (cold, hungry, tired…)
Au moins 2 négations différentes (isn't, aren't, I'm not)
Utilise le verbe be au présent au moins 5 fois

prompts.model: Hi Emma! I'm at the campground with my family. It's eight o'clock and I'm cold, I'm hungry and I'm very tired. My dad is happy, but my mom isn't happy. The tent is wet! My brothers aren't cold. They are in their sleeping bags with the dog. Are you at home? You are lucky! Bye, Amir

prompts.title: Avis de recherche
prompts.prompt: Tu dois retrouver ton oncle Sam à l'aéroport de Toronto, mais l'agent ne le connaît pas. Décris-le : sa taille, ses cheveux, ses yeux et un détail amusant. Utilise has et is.

require.label: Utilise has (He has short hair…)
Au moins 4 adjectifs de description différents
Utilise le présent (is, has) au moins 4 fois

prompts.model: Hello! This is a description of my uncle Sam. He is tall and thin. He has short grey hair and a big beard. His eyes are blue. He has big glasses and a red backpack. He isn't young: he is sixty. He is very friendly and he is always hungry, so he is probably at the café!

prompts.title: Ma semaine de fou
prompts.prompt: Un collègue (ou un coéquipier) veut organiser une réunion. Réponds-lui : dis quels jours tu es libre ou occupé(e), à quelle heure (at half past two…), et pose-lui une question.

require.label: Au moins 3 jours de la semaine (avec une majuscule !)
Utilise on, at et in (on Monday, at ten o'clock, in the morning)
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model:
Hi Priya,
This week is crazy! I'm busy on Monday and Tuesday. On Wednesday, I'm free in the morning, but I'm not free in the afternoon. On Thursday, I'm free at half past two. Is Thursday OK for you? The meeting room is free at three o'clock, too. Thanks!
Karim

prompts.title: À qui est-ce ?
prompts.prompt: Après une soirée pyjama, il reste plein d'objets chez toi ! Écris un message au groupe : dis à qui est chaque objet (Maya's toothbrush, the twins' pillows, It's mine…) et pose au moins une question avec Whose.

require.label: Au moins 2 pronoms possessifs différents (mine, yours, theirs…)
Pose une question avec Whose
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model: Hi everyone! Thanks for the sleepover! Now my room is a mess. The pink toothbrush is Maya's. The blue socks are Noah's. The twins' pillows are on my bed. Are they theirs? Yes, they are! The green pyjamas aren't mine. Are they yours, Chloé? And whose is this big teddy bear? It isn't my brother's. Bye! Zoé

prompts.title: Invitation d'anniversaire
prompts.prompt: Invite tes amis (ou ta famille) à ton anniversaire : la date, l'heure, le lieu, qui sera là et comment tu te sens. Attention aux prépositions : on Saturday, at two o'clock, in May.

require.label: Écris le mois (avec une majuscule !)
Utilise on, at et in
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model:
Hi Olivia!
My birthday is on Saturday, May fourteenth. I'm twelve! The party is at my house at two o'clock. My house is on Maple Street. My cousins are there, too. Are you free? It's in the spring, so the party is in the backyard. I'm very excited! See you soon,
Lucas

prompts.title: Les animaux de mon quartier
prompts.prompt: Décris les animaux qui vivent autour de chez toi (écureuils, oies, ratons laveurs, souris…) : combien il y en a et comment ils sont. Attention aux pluriels irréguliers (mice, geese, sheep…).

require.label: Au moins 3 noms d'animaux au pluriel (attention : mice, geese…)
Utilise le présent (there are, they are, they have…) au moins 4 fois
Cite au moins une couleur

prompts.model: I live near a forest, so there are a lot of animals. There are five squirrels in my backyard. They are grey and very fast. There are two foxes, too. They have long tails. In the fall, there are geese in the field. At night, the mice in the garage are a problem! My cat isn't interested. She is lazy.

prompts.title: Rendez-vous chez le médecin
prompts.prompt: Tu es malade. Écris à la clinique : décris comment tu te sens (I'm tired, my head is hot… et pas « I have hot » !) et demande un rendez-vous en précisant quand tu es libre.

require.label: Au moins 2 états (I'm tired, I'm cold…)
Au moins un jour de la semaine
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model:
Hello,
My name is Ana Silva. I'm sick. I'm very tired and I'm cold, but my head is hot. My throat is red. I'm not hungry, but I'm always thirsty. Is the doctor free on Tuesday or Wednesday? I'm free in the morning, at nine o'clock or at half past ten. Thank you,
Ana Silva

prompts.title: Ma journée type
prompts.prompt: Ta nouvelle correspondante de Vancouver veut savoir comment se passe une journée d'école pour toi. Écris-lui un courriel : ce que tu fais le matin, à l'école et le soir, avec des heures. Termine par une question pour elle.

require.label: Utilise le présent simple (au moins 6 verbes)
Utilise au moins 2 mots de liaison (and, but, then…)
Au moins 2 adverbes de fréquence différents (always, usually, never…)

prompts.model:
Hi Mei!
Here is my typical school day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock, but I don't get up right away. Then I have breakfast with my brother. We always eat toast with peanut butter. I go to school by bus. School starts at half past eight. After school, I sometimes play soccer with my friends, and then I do my homework. I never go to bed before nine. What about you? What time do you get up?
Write soon!
Félix

prompts.title: La maison de mes rêves
prompts.prompt: Décris la maison (ou l'appartement) de tes rêves : les pièces, les meubles et où ils sont (next to, under, between…). Ajoute au moins un détail complètement fou !

require.label: Utilise there is / there are
Au moins 4 prépositions de lieu différentes (in, under, next to, behind…)
Utilise le présent simple (au moins 5 verbes)

prompts.model: My dream house is in the mountains near Vancouver. There are four bedrooms and three bathrooms. In my bedroom, there is a big bed next to the window and a desk under a giant poster. The kitchen is between the living room and the games room. There is a pool table in the games room! Behind the house, there is a hot tub. And on the roof, there is a slide that goes down to the lake. It's perfect!

prompts.title: Le frigo de la famille
prompts.prompt: Avant d'aller à l'épicerie, tu fais l'inventaire du frigo. Écris une note pour ta famille : ce qu'il y a et ce qu'il n'y a pas (some / any), en quelle quantité (a lot of, a few, too much…), et demande ce qu'il faut acheter (How much…? How many…?).

require.label: Utilise some ET any
Au moins 3 mots de quantité différents (much, many, a lot of, a few…)
Pose au moins une question avec How much ou How many

prompts.model:
Hi family! Before I go to the grocery store, here is the list. There is some milk, but there isn't any cheese. There are a few eggs, but not many. We have a lot of yogurt, so we don't need any. There isn't any fruit! How many apples do we need? Ten? And how much bread do you want? We have too much ketchup and no mustard. Please write your ideas on the list. Thanks!
Mom

prompts.title: Questions pour un correspondant
prompts.prompt: Tu as un nouveau correspondant à Toronto. Écris-lui un premier courriel : parle un peu de toi, puis pose-lui au moins 4 questions sur sa vie (Do you…? Does your sister…? Where do you…?).

require.label: Pose au moins 4 questions
Utilise do ET does dans tes questions
Utilise le présent simple (au moins 5 verbes)

prompts.model:
Hi Ethan!
My name is Léa and I'm your new pen pal. I live in Montreal with my mom and my two cats. I love music and I play the guitar. Now I have some questions for you! Where do you live in Toronto? Do you have any brothers or sisters? Does your school have a band? What do you do on weekends? I don't like homework, so please don't ask about that!
Write back soon!
Léa

prompts.title: Cherche colocataire
prompts.prompt: Tu cherches un(e) colocataire pour ton appartement. Écris une annonce où tu décris tes habitudes : ce que tu fais souvent, ce que tu ne fais jamais, ce que tu aimes et ce que tu détestes.

require.label: Utilise au moins une négation (don't / doesn't)
Au moins 3 adverbes de fréquence différents
Utilise le présent simple (au moins 6 verbes)

prompts.model:
Hello! I need a roommate for my apartment in Ottawa. Here is some information about me. I work in a bank, so I usually get up early. I always clean the kitchen after dinner. I often cook, and I sometimes make pizza for everyone! I don't smoke and I don't have pets. I never play loud music after ten o'clock. I hate a messy bathroom. Do you like quiet evenings? Then we are a good match! Call me.
Karim

prompts.title: Le menu de la cafétéria
prompts.prompt: La cafétéria de ton école (ou de ton travail) veut changer son menu. Écris un message au comité : ce que tu manges d'habitude, ce que tu aimes ou n'aimes pas, et ce que tu voudrais (I'd like…).

require.label: Exprime tes goûts avec au moins 2 verbes différents (like, love, hate)
Fais une demande polie avec I'd like…
Utilise le présent simple (au moins 5 verbes)

prompts.model:
Dear cafeteria committee,
I eat at the cafeteria every day. I usually have a sandwich and some soup. I love the chicken soup, but I hate the fish sticks. They are too dry! My friends don't like the salads, because there isn't any dressing. Here are my ideas. I'd like more fruit, like bananas and oranges. I'd also like a pasta day every Friday. And please, we need a lot of chocolate milk!
Thank you,
Jaden, grade six

prompts.title: Les jumeaux
prompts.prompt: Décris deux personnes de ta famille ou deux amis très différents (ou deux animaux !) : ce qu'ils font tous les deux (both), ce que chacun fait (each), ce qu'ils font tous les jours (every day).

require.label: Au moins 3 mots différents parmi both, each, every, all, none
Utilise le présent simple (au moins 6 verbes)
Utilise au moins 2 mots de liaison (and, but, so…)

prompts.model: My cousins Noah and Liam are twins, but they are very different. They both have red hair and they both live in Kingston. Noah gets up early every day and reads in bed. Liam always sleeps until noon! Each twin has a pet. Noah has a calm old cat, and Liam has a crazy puppy. They both love pizza, but none of their friends like their pizza with pineapple and pickles. On weekends, they all play hockey together.

prompts.title: Bienvenue au Canada
prompts.prompt: Un collègue français arrive au Canada en janvier. Écris-lui un courriel : comment est l'hiver ici, ce que les gens font d'habitude en hiver, et les vêtements qu'il faut avoir (a toque, mittens…).

require.label: Utilise le présent simple (au moins 6 verbes)
Utilise au moins 2 mots de liaison (and, but, so…)
Au moins 2 adverbes de fréquence différents

prompts.model:
Hi Thomas,
Welcome to Ottawa! Winter here is very cold. In January, it is often minus twenty degrees, and it snows a lot. But people don't stay at home! They usually skate on the Rideau Canal, and many families go skiing on weekends. You need some warm clothes: a good coat, boots, mittens and a toque. Do you have any of those? I have an extra toque for you, so don't buy one.
See you soon!
Maya

prompts.title: En direct du chalet
prompts.prompt: Tu es dans un endroit plein d'action (un chalet, une fête, un parc…). Écris un message à un ami pour lui raconter ce qui se passe autour de toi en ce moment : qui fait quoi ?

require.label: Utilise le présent continu (am/is/are + -ing) au moins 5 fois
Utilise au moins 2 mots de liaison (and, but, so…)
Dis « en ce moment » (now, right now, at the moment)

prompts.model:
Hi Sofia! I'm at my grandma's cottage right now, and it's total chaos. My uncle is cooking burgers on the barbecue, but he is burning them. My little cousins are swimming in the lake and they are screaming. The dog is chasing a duck! Grandma is sitting on the dock and she is laughing. And me? I'm hiding in the hammock with my phone, and I'm writing to you. What are you doing?
Noah

prompts.title: Spectacle de talents
prompts.prompt: Pour le spectacle de talents de l'école, présente-toi : ce que tu sais faire (can), ce que tu ne sais pas faire (can't), ce que tu aimes faire (love / enjoy + -ing) et ce pour quoi tu es doué(e) (good at + -ing).

require.label: Utilise can ET can't
Utilise good at + -ing
Au moins 2 verbes de goût différents (love, enjoy, like + -ing)

prompts.model: Hi! My name is Malik and I'm in grade seven. I can juggle with three balls, and I can skate backwards. I'm good at telling jokes, too! But I can't sing. When I sing, my dog leaves the room. I can't dance very well, either. I love playing hockey and I enjoy making funny videos with my sister. For the talent show, I can juggle and tell jokes at the same time. Is that a talent? I think so!

prompts.title: Comment venir chez moi
prompts.prompt: Un ami (ou un nouveau collègue) vient chez toi pour la première fois, depuis l'arrêt d'autobus. Écris-lui le chemin : au moins 4 instructions à l'impératif (Turn left, Walk straight…) et des repères (next to, across from, on the corner).

require.label: Au moins 3 verbes différents à l'impératif (turn, walk, cross…)
Utilise left, right et straight
Au moins 2 repères différents (next to, across from, on the corner…)

prompts.model:
Hi Ethan! Here are the directions to my house. Get off the bus at Bank Street. Walk straight for two blocks. At the traffic lights, turn left. You can see a big library on the corner. Don't go past the library! Turn right on Elm Street. My house is the blue one, across from the park, next to a small bakery. Don't knock, because the baby is sleeping. Just send me a message. See you soon!
Emma

prompts.title: Au centre commercial
prompts.prompt: Tu es au centre commercial et tu cherches un manteau d'hiver. Écris à ton/ta partenaire (ou à un ami) pour demander son avis : décris 2 ou 3 articles (this, these, those), leur prix et le problème de taille.

require.label: Utilise au moins 3 démonstratifs différents (this, these, those…)
Parle du prix ou de la taille (dollars, expensive, size…)
Pose au moins 2 questions

prompts.model:
Hi Ana! I'm at the mall and I'm looking for a winter coat. This black coat is really warm, but it's too expensive: three hundred dollars! These grey coats are cheap, but they aren't big enough. I can't find my size. And look at those boots in the window! They are on sale for eighty dollars. Do you like them? Is the black coat OK, or is it too long for me? Call me quickly!
Karim

prompts.title: Le nouveau stagiaire
prompts.prompt: Ta patronne veut des nouvelles du stagiaire (ou de la stagiaire) de ton équipe. Écris-lui un courriel : comment il/elle travaille (quickly, carefully, well…) et ce qu'il/elle fait cette semaine.

require.label: Au moins 3 adverbes de manière différents (carefully, fast, well…)
Utilise very, really, too ou enough (au moins 2)
Utilise le présent continu au moins 2 fois (this week, she is…)

prompts.model:
Hi Mrs. Wong,
Here is some news about Priya, our new intern. She works really hard and she learns fast. She speaks politely to our clients and she writes her reports carefully. She is very good at spreadsheets, too! This week, she is organizing the files and she is helping Liam with the website. There is one small problem: she types too quickly and she sometimes makes mistakes. But she is improving every day.
Best regards,
Félix

prompts.title: Photo de vacances
prompts.prompt: Décris une photo (vraie ou imaginaire) de ta famille en vacances : où vous êtes, ce que chacun porte et ce que chacun fait. Le plus drôle sera le mieux !

require.label: Utilise le présent continu (is wearing, are playing…) au moins 5 fois
Décris au moins 2 vêtements (wearing a hat…)
Utilise aussi le présent simple (I love…, It is…) au moins 2 fois

prompts.model: In this photo, my family is at the beach in Prince Edward Island. My dad is wearing a funny hat and big sunglasses. He is reading a book, but he is sleeping, too! My mom is swimming. My little sister is building a sandcastle, and the seagulls are stealing her chips. My brother is wearing red shorts and he is playing volleyball. I'm not in the photo, because I'm taking it! I love this picture.

prompts.title: Vente de garage
prompts.prompt: Tu organises une vente de garage. Écris une annonce pour le groupe du quartier : ce que tu vends (this lamp, these skates…), les prix, et ce que les gens peuvent faire (You can pay…, You can come…).

require.label: Donne des prix (dollars, cents…)
Utilise can
Utilise au moins 2 démonstratifs différents (this, these, those…)

prompts.model:
Garage sale this Saturday!
Hi neighbours! We are moving, so we are selling a lot of things. We have kids' clothes, books, toys and a bike. The books are only one dollar each. Do you need a lamp? This lamp is fifteen dollars. These hockey skates are twenty dollars, and those ski boots are only ten. You can come from nine o'clock to two o'clock. You can pay cash or by e-transfer. See you on Saturday!
The Nguyen family, Oak Street

prompts.title: Désolé, je suis débordé !
prompts.prompt: Un ami t'invite à sortir vendredi, mais tu ne peux pas. Explique ce que tu fais d'habitude le vendredi (présent simple) et pourquoi cette semaine est différente (présent continu). Propose une autre date.

require.label: Utilise le présent simple pour tes habitudes (au moins 3 verbes)
Utilise le présent continu pour cette semaine (au moins 3 verbes)
Utilise can't pour refuser poliment

prompts.model:
Hi Olivia,
Thanks for the invitation! Usually, I'm free on Friday nights. I go to the movies or I play video games with my brother. But this week is different. My parents are painting the kitchen, so I'm helping them. My grandparents are staying with us, too, and I'm sleeping on the sofa! I'm also studying for a big math test. So I can't come on Friday, sorry. Can we go next weekend?
Love,
Chloé

prompts.title: La pire journée de ma vie
prompts.prompt: Raconte une journée (vraie ou inventée) où tout est allé de travers, du réveil jusqu'au soir. Utilise des mots pour enchaîner les étapes (first, then, after that, finally) et termine par une chute drôle.

require.label: Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 8 verbes : woke up, ran, didn't…)
Au moins 3 mots de séquence différents (first, then, after that, finally…)
Un repère dans le passé (yesterday, last Monday, two days ago)

prompts.model: Last Monday was a terrible day. First, my alarm didn't ring, so I woke up at eight o'clock. I jumped out of bed and I put on my shirt inside out. Then I ran to the bus stop, but the bus left without me. After that, it started to rain and I didn't have an umbrella. When I got to school, my teacher looked at me and smiled. "Noah, it's a PD day. There's no school today!" I walked home in the rain. Finally, I made some hot chocolate and went back to bed. It was the best part of the day!

prompts.title: Mes vacances
prompts.prompt: Écris à un ami pour lui raconter tes dernières vacances : où tu es allé(e), avec qui, ce que tu as fait et mangé, et un petit problème. Pose-lui au moins 2 questions sur ses vacances (Did you…? What did you…?).

require.label: Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 8 verbes)
Pose au moins 2 questions
Utilise did ET didn't

prompts.model:
Hi Amir!
Last week, my family and I went to Quebec City. We stayed in a small hotel near the old town. On the first day, we visited the Château Frontenac and we took a lot of photos. The next day, we ate crêpes with maple syrup for breakfast. Delicious! There was one problem: my little brother lost his shoe in the river. We didn't find it, so he wore my sandals all day! What did you do during the holidays? Did you go to the cottage?
Write soon!
Léa

prompts.title: Le mystère du gâteau disparu
prompts.prompt: Hier, le gâteau d'anniversaire a disparu de la cuisine ! Raconte : ce que chaque personne faisait au moment de la disparition (past continuous), ce que tu as découvert, et qui était le coupable.

require.label: Utilise le passé continu (was/were + -ing) au moins 3 fois
Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 6 verbes)
Utilise when ET while

prompts.model: Yesterday was my mom's birthday, and we had a beautiful chocolate cake. At four o'clock, the cake disappeared! While my dad was washing the dishes, my sister was reading in the living room. My grandpa was sleeping on the sofa, of course. And what was I doing? I was decorating the table. Suddenly, I heard a noise in the kitchen. When I opened the door, I saw chocolate on the floor. There were small footprints everywhere! I followed them to the backyard. Our dog Max was lying under a tree with a very happy face.

prompts.title: Ma valise a disparu
prompts.prompt: La semaine dernière, la compagnie aérienne a perdu ta valise. Écris-lui un courriel : raconte ce qui s'est passé à l'arrivée, ce que tu as fait, ce que tu n'as pas pu récupérer, et ce que tu demandes maintenant.

require.label: Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 8 verbes)
Au moins 2 formes négatives différentes (didn't, wasn't…)
Un repère dans le passé (last Friday, two days ago…)

prompts.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Last Friday, I flew from Toronto to Halifax with your airline. The plane left two hours late, but that wasn't the real problem. When I arrived in Halifax, I waited for my suitcase for an hour. It didn't come. I went to the information desk and I filled out a form. The agent was very nice, but she didn't know where my suitcase was. Now, five days later, I still don't have my clothes or my son's birthday present. Please find my suitcase quickly, or pay for my new things.
Sincerely,
Samuel Roy

prompts.title: C'était mieux avant ?
prompts.prompt: Interroge un grand-parent (ou imagine sa réponse) : comment était sa vie quand il/elle avait ton âge ? Raconte ce qu'il/elle faisait souvent (used to, would), ce qu'il/elle ne faisait pas (didn't use to), et compare avec aujourd'hui.

require.label: Utilise used to pour les habitudes passées
Une phrase avec didn't use to
Compare avec aujourd'hui : au moins 2 verbes au présent simple

prompts.model: When my grandma Rose was a child in Sudbury, life was very different. She used to walk two kilometres to school, even in winter. She didn't use to have a television at home, so she used to listen to the radio with her brothers. On Saturdays, her family would go to the lake and fish all day. There were no cellphones, of course! If she wanted to talk to a friend, she knocked on the door. Today, Grandma has a tablet and she sends me funny videos every morning. She says life is easier now, but she misses the quiet evenings.

prompts.title: Le spectacle de l'école
prompts.prompt: Écris une critique du dernier spectacle, film ou match que tu as vu : ce qui s'est passé, ce que tu as aimé, ce que tu n'as pas aimé, et ta note sur cinq.

require.label: Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 6 verbes)
Utilise au moins 3 mots de liaison différents (and, but, because…)
Donne ton avis avec au moins 2 mots (loved, boring, funny…)

prompts.model: Last Thursday, I went to our school's winter show with my parents. The grade six students performed a play about a penguin who wanted to fly. The story was simple, but it was very funny. I loved the costumes, especially the penguin's orange feet! The music was great, too, because the school band played live. But the show was too long. It started at seven and finished at half past nine, and my little brother fell asleep. Also, one actor forgot his lines, but the audience clapped anyway. I give it four stars out of five!

prompts.title: Une rencontre inattendue
prompts.prompt: Raconte une rencontre inattendue (un animal sauvage, une personne célèbre, un vieil ami…). Que faisais-tu quand c'est arrivé ? Comment as-tu réagi ? Comment l'histoire s'est-elle terminée ?

require.label: Utilise le passé continu au moins 2 fois (I was walking…)
Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 7 verbes)
Au moins 2 mots parmi suddenly, when, while

prompts.model: Two summers ago, I was hiking in Algonquin Park with my uncle. While we were walking quietly along a lake, my uncle was telling me a boring story about his job. Suddenly, he stopped. A huge moose was standing in the water, very close to us! It was eating plants and it didn't see us. We didn't move. My heart was beating very fast. I slowly took out my phone and took three photos. Then the moose looked up, made a strange noise and walked into the forest. My uncle never finished his boring story. I still have the photos!

prompts.title: Ma première semaine au travail
prompts.prompt: Tu as commencé un nouveau travail lundi dernier. Écris à un ami : ce qui s'est bien passé, ce qui s'est mal passé, les gens que tu as rencontrés. Pose-lui une question sur sa semaine.

require.label: Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 8 verbes)
Au moins 2 mots de séquence différents (first, then, after that…)
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model:
Hi Jaden,
Guess what? Last Monday, I started my new job at the hospital! On the first day, I met my boss, Dr. Patel. She was very kind and she showed me the whole building. Then I got my uniform, but it was two sizes too big! On Tuesday, I helped a nurse with the patients, and I learned a lot. Wednesday was hard, because I got lost three times. After that, my colleague Mei drew a map for me. On Friday, we all went out for lunch together. I think I'm going to like it here. How was your week?
Ana

prompts.title: Le programme du week-end
prompts.prompt: Un ami vient passer la fin de semaine chez toi. Écris-lui le programme : ce qui est déjà organisé (We're playing…, My mom is picking you up…), ce que vous allez faire (going to) et tes prédictions pour la météo (It will…).

require.label: Utilise le futur (will, going to) au moins 4 fois
Utilise le présent continu pour ce qui est déjà organisé (au moins 2 fois)
Pose au moins une question

prompts.model:
Hi Lucas!
I can't wait for the weekend! Here is the plan. Your train arrives at six on Friday, so my mom is picking you up at the station. On Saturday morning, we're playing in a hockey tournament. I hope we'll win! In the afternoon, we're going to build a snow fort in the park. On Sunday, my dad is going to make his famous pancakes. The forecast says it will snow a lot, so bring your warmest boots. I think it'll be the best weekend ever! Do you want to see a movie on Saturday night?
See you soon,
Maya

prompts.title: Ville ou campagne ?
prompts.prompt: Compare deux endroits que tu connais bien (ta ville et celle de tes grands-parents, la ville et la campagne…) : lequel est plus grand, plus calme, plus cher, plus sympathique ? Dis où tu voudrais vivre plus tard.

require.label: Au moins 3 mots de comparaison différents (than, more, better, the best…)
Au moins 2 superlatifs différents (the best, the worst, the friendliest…)
Utilise au moins 3 mots de liaison différents (but, so, because…)

prompts.model: I grew up in a small village near Rimouski, but now I live in Montreal. The two places are very different. Montreal is much bigger and busier than my village, of course. There are more restaurants, more shows and more jobs. But life in the city is more expensive, and the traffic is the worst thing about it! My village is quieter and the air is cleaner. People are friendlier, too, because everyone knows your name. For me, the best place is somewhere in between. In the future, I'm going to buy a house in a small town near the city. Then I'll have the best of both worlds!

prompts.title: Le club Aventure
prompts.prompt: Tu veux entrer dans le club Aventure de ton école. Écris au responsable : 3 choses que tu as déjà faites (I've been…, I've seen…), 2 choses que tu n'as jamais faites, et pose-lui une question avec Have you ever…?

require.label: Utilise le present perfect au moins 5 fois (I've climbed, I've never…)
Utilise never ET ever
Utilise been (I've been to…)

prompts.model:
Hi Mr. Kowalski,
I would like to join the Adventure Club. Here are my experiences. I've been camping in Algonquin Park three times, and I've slept in a tent in the rain. I've also climbed a mountain in the Rockies with my aunt. I've seen a black bear, but it was far away, luckily! I've never gone canoeing, and I've never been to the Arctic. Have you ever seen the northern lights? That's my dream! I'm brave and I always listen to instructions. I hope I can join!
Thank you,
Jaden

prompts.title: Nouvelles d'Halifax
prompts.prompt: Tu as déménagé dans une nouvelle ville il y a quelques mois. Écris à ton ancienne voisine : depuis combien de temps tu es là (for / since), ce que tu as déjà fait (already, just) et ce que tu n'as pas encore fait (yet).

require.label: Utilise for ET since
Au moins 2 mots parmi already, yet, just
Utilise le present perfect au moins 4 fois

prompts.model:
Dear Mrs. Leblanc,
How are you? I've lived in Halifax for four months now, and I've already fallen in love with the ocean! I've worked at the library since March. My colleagues are very friendly, and I've just joined their bowling team. I'm terrible at bowling, but it's fun. I've already tried lobster and I've visited the Citadel twice. But I haven't found a good bakery yet. Nothing is as good as Mr. Dubois's croissants! Have you met the new neighbours yet? I miss our chats on the balcony.
Hugs,
Olivia

prompts.title: Lettre à moi dans 20 ans
prompts.prompt: Écris une lettre à la personne que tu seras dans vingt ans : ce que tu vas faire bientôt (going to), ce que tu penses qu'elle sera devenue (You'll be…), et compare sa vie avec ta vie actuelle (taller, busier, better at…).

require.label: Utilise le futur (will, going to) au moins 5 fois
Au moins 2 mots de comparaison (than, more, better…)
Utilise au moins 2 mots de liaison différents

prompts.model:
Dear Future Me,
Hello from the past! Right now, you are eleven, and you are writing this letter in your bedroom. In twenty years, I think you'll be a vet, because you love animals more than anything. You'll probably live in Vancouver, near the ocean. Will you have a dog? I hope so! Next year, you're going to start high school, so you'll be busier than now. I'm sure you'll be taller than Dad, and maybe you'll be better at math than me! Please don't forget your old friends. And don't worry if life is harder than you think.
Love,
Me

prompts.title: Le meilleur brunch du quartier
prompts.prompt: Écris un avis en ligne sur un restaurant ou un café de ton quartier : compare-le aux autres, dis ce que tu y as déjà goûté, et si tu vas y retourner.

require.label: Au moins 2 superlatifs différents (the best, the longest…)
Utilise le present perfect au moins 2 fois (I've tried…)
Dis si tu vas y retourner (I'll…, I'm going to…)

prompts.model:
Chez Mimi: five stars!
I've eaten at a lot of brunch places in Ottawa, but Chez Mimi is the best one in the neighbourhood. The portions are bigger than at other cafés, and the prices are lower. I've tried the blueberry pancakes and the vegetarian omelette, and both were delicious. The coffee is stronger than at the big chains, which I love. The only problem is the line: on Sunday mornings, it's the longest line in town! Go early, or you'll wait for thirty minutes. The staff are the friendliest people I've ever met. I'll definitely go back next weekend.

prompts.title: La réunion de famille
prompts.prompt: Tu écris à ta tante pour vérifier les détails de la grande réunion de famille. Utilise des question tags pour confirmer (It's on Saturday, isn't it?) et réagis à ce qu'elle aime ou n'aime pas (So do I / Neither do I).

require.label: Au moins 3 questions (les question tags comptent !)
Au moins 3 question tags différents (…, isn't it? …, haven't you?)
Réagis avec So do I, Neither do I ou Me too

prompts.model:
Hi Aunt Sara!
I'm so excited about the family reunion! It's on Saturday, isn't it? And it starts at noon, doesn't it? Grandpa is making his famous chili. You've tasted it before, haven't you? It's the spiciest chili in Canada! Mom says you don't like spicy food. Neither do I, so I'm going to bring a big salad. The cousins from Winnipeg are coming, too, aren't they? I haven't seen them since last summer. You won't forget the board games, will you? Last year was the funniest reunion ever.
See you on Saturday!
Zoé

prompts.title: Quel téléphone choisir ?
prompts.prompt: Tu dois choisir entre deux téléphones (ou deux forfaits). Écris à ton parent (ou à ton ado) : compare le prix, la batterie et l'appareil photo (cheaper than, as good as…), puis annonce ton choix.

require.label: Compare avec than ET as … as
Au moins 3 mots de comparaison différents (than, better, less…)
Annonce ton choix au futur (I'm going to…, I'll…) au moins 2 fois

prompts.model:
Hi Dad,
I've compared the two phones, and here's what I found. The Zento X is cheaper than the Pixa Pro: it's only four hundred dollars, and the Pixa is six hundred. But the Pixa has a better camera and its battery lasts longer. The Zento's screen is as big as the Pixa's, and it's lighter, too. Honestly, the Zento isn't as fast as the Pixa, but it's fast enough for me, and it's less fragile. I'm going to choose the Zento, and I'll pay for half of it with my birthday money. Is that OK? I promise I'll take care of it!
Thanks,
Ethan

prompts.title: Conseils au nouvel élève
prompts.prompt: Un nouvel élève arrive dans ton école. Écris-lui un courriel de bienvenue : ce qu'il doit faire (must, have to), ce qui est interdit (mustn't), ce qu'il n'est pas obligé de faire (don't have to) et tes meilleurs conseils (should, could).

require.label: Utilise au moins 6 modaux (must, have to, should, could…)
Distingue mustn't (interdit) et don't have to (pas obligé)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Hi Samir,

Welcome to Riverside Middle School! I know the first week can be scary, so here are some tips from someone who survived it.

First, the rules. You must wear running shoes in the gym, and you have to be in class before the bell at eight thirty. You mustn't use your phone in class, or the teacher will take it until the end of the day. Believe me, I know! But you don't have to bring a lunch every day, because the cafeteria is pretty good, especially on pizza Fridays.

Now, my advice. You should join a club in September, because it's the best way to make friends. You could try the robotics club, or you might like the drama club. And you should never sit on the third chair in the library. It's broken!

See you in the halls,
Priya

prompts.title: Petits gestes, grands effets
prompts.prompt: Le journal de l'école (ou du quartier) prépare un numéro sur l'environnement. Écris un article : ce qui arrivera si on ne change rien, ce qui arrivera si chacun fait un petit effort, et 2 idées concrètes. Attention : pas de will après if !

require.label: Utilise le futur (will) au moins 4 fois dans tes conséquences
Utilise if, unless et when
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Small Changes, Big Results

Every week, our neighbourhood fills hundreds of garbage bags with plastic. If we don't change our habits, our parks and rivers will soon be full of waste. Unless we act now, the problem will only get worse.

The good news is that small changes really work. If every family brings reusable bags to the grocery store, we will save thousands of plastic bags every year. When you buy a drink, you can bring your own bottle. If you forget it, ask for a glass instead of a plastic cup.

Here are two easy ideas for our school. First, we could organize a clean-up day in the spring. Second, the cafeteria should stop selling water in plastic bottles. If we work together, our neighbourhood will be cleaner, and we'll feel proud of it.

By Maya Singh, grade eight

prompts.title: Conseils pour mieux dormir
prompts.prompt: Ton ami(e) dort mal et est stressé(e) par le travail. Écris-lui un courriel de conseils : ce qu'il/elle devrait faire (should), ce qu'il/elle pourrait essayer (could, try + -ing), ce qu'il/elle doit éviter (avoid + -ing) et quand consulter.

require.label: Utilise au moins 5 modaux (should, could, must, might…)
Au moins 2 verbes suivis de -ing ou de to (avoid drinking, try going…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Hi Karim,

I'm sorry to hear that you're not sleeping well. Work has been crazy for you lately, hasn't it? I'm not a doctor, but here are a few ideas that helped me last year.

First, you should avoid drinking coffee after lunch. I know you love your double-double, but caffeine can keep you awake for hours. You could also try going for a walk after dinner, because fresh air really helps. And you must stop checking your work emails in bed! Your phone should stay in the kitchen at night.

If you still can't sleep after two weeks, you should see your doctor. You might need to take a few days off, too. Remember, nobody can work well when they're exhausted.

Take care of yourself, and let me know how it goes!
Nadia

prompts.title: Le jour où j'ai demandé une « librairie »
prompts.prompt: Raconte une erreur embarrassante (vraie ou inventée) causée par un faux ami (library / librairie, deception / déception, attend / attendre…). Explique ce qui s'est passé, ce que le mot veut vraiment dire, et donne un conseil aux autres francophones.

require.label: Au moins 3 faux amis bien utilisés (actually, library, bookstore…)
Utilise le passé simple anglais (au moins 5 verbes)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
The Day I Asked for a "Librairie"

Last summer, I was visiting my cousins in Toronto. One afternoon, I wanted to buy a novel, so I asked a man in the street, "Excuse me, where is the library?" He kindly showed me the way. Twenty minutes later, I was standing in front of a huge building full of books, but nothing was for sale! Actually, a library is a place where you borrow books. If you want to buy them, you have to go to a bookstore.

I felt a little silly, but the story got worse. When I told my cousin about my "deception", she looked worried. In English, that word means tricking someone! The right word was "disappointment".

So here is my advice: you must be careful with English words that look French. Eventually, you'll learn them all, but until then, check a good dictionary.

prompts.title: Le grand voyage en Gaspésie
prompts.prompt: Tu organises un voyage en famille ou entre amis. Écris un courriel aux participants : ce que vous ferez (will), ce que tu as décidé ou espères faire (decide to, hope to, suggest + -ing…), et ce que chacun doit prévoir.

require.label: Utilise le futur (will, going to) au moins 4 fois
Au moins 3 verbes différents suivis de to ou de -ing (decide to, enjoy -ing, suggest -ing…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Hi everyone,

Only one week until our trip to the Gaspé Peninsula! I'm so excited that I can't stop checking the weather. We'll leave Montreal at six on Saturday morning, and by the evening, we'll be in Percé.

Here's the plan. I've decided to book a whale-watching tour for Sunday morning. I hope to see a humpback whale, but I can't promise anything! On Monday, I suggest taking the boat to Bonaventure Island to see the gannets. There are thousands of them, so it will be noisy! I'll print all our tickets before Friday, so you don't have to worry about them.

Please remember to pack warm clothes. Even in July, it can be cold near the ocean. And if anyone minds sleeping in a tent, tell me now! I really enjoy organizing trips, but I don't enjoy surprises.

See you soon,
Félix

prompts.title: Instructions pour garder mon chien
prompts.prompt: Ton ami va garder ton chien pendant tes vacances. Écris-lui un message avec des instructions : ce qu'il doit faire, ce qui arrive si… (If she barks, it means…), et ce qu'il ne doit surtout pas faire.

require.label: Utilise if, unless et when
Utilise au moins 4 modaux (have to, must, mustn't, can…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Hi Liam,

Thank you so much for looking after Pepper while I'm away! She's a sweet dog, but she has some strange habits, so please read this carefully.

You have to feed her twice a day, at seven in the morning and at five in the evening. If she sits by the door and whines, it means she needs to go out. Don't panic if she hides under the bed during a storm. She always does that. When she brings you her blue ball, you must throw it. If you don't, she will follow you everywhere until you do!

You mustn't give her chocolate or grapes, because they can make dogs very sick. And unless you want a very muddy dog, don't walk her near the pond.

Thanks again! I'll bring you back some maple candy.
Emma

prompts.title: Un téléphone à 10 ans ?
prompts.prompt: Rédige un court essai : les enfants de 10 ans devraient-ils avoir un téléphone intelligent ? Présente les avantages, puis les inconvénients, et donne ton opinion en conclusion.

require.label: Utilise au moins 5 modaux (can, might, should, could…)
Utilise au moins 4 mots de liaison différents (but, because, also, on the other hand…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 4 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Should Ten-Year-Olds Have a Smartphone?

Today, many children get their first phone before they start high school. Some parents think it is necessary, but others are worried.

On the one hand, a phone can be very useful. Children who take the bus alone can call their parents if there is a problem. They might also use educational apps to practise math or learn a language. Besides, if all their friends have a phone, a child without one may feel left out.

On the other hand, smartphones can be addictive. Many kids stop playing outside because they prefer watching videos. They could also see things online that are not suitable for their age. Parents should not underestimate these dangers.

In my opinion, ten-year-olds don't need a smartphone. A simple phone for calls and messages is enough. They can wait until they are older and more responsible.

prompts.title: Postuler pour un emploi d'été
prompts.prompt: Tu postules pour un emploi d'été (camp de jour, piscine, épicerie…). Écris un courriel au responsable : pourquoi tu veux ce poste (I hope to…), ce que tu aimes faire (I enjoy + -ing), ce que tu sais faire (I can…) et tes disponibilités.

require.label: Au moins 3 verbes différents suivis de to ou de -ing (enjoy -ing, hope to…)
Utilise au moins 3 modaux (can, could, should…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Dear Ms. Fortin,

I am writing to apply for the job of day camp counsellor at your community centre. I saw your ad on the centre's website, and I would really love to work with you this summer.

I am sixteen and I have a lot of experience with children. I often babysit my neighbours' kids, and last summer I helped at a soccer camp in my town. I enjoy organizing games and I'm good at calming down kids who are upset. I also have my first aid certificate, so I can react quickly if someone gets hurt. I could also help with swimming lessons, because I am a strong swimmer. I hope to study education at university, so this job would be perfect for me.

I am available from the end of June until the end of August, and I can work on weekends if necessary. I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Ana Moreau

prompts.title: Si j'étais maire
prompts.prompt: Si tu étais maire de ta ville (ou directeur de ton école) pendant une semaine, que changerais-tu ? Écris un article avec 3 idées et explique ce qui se passerait (If I were…, I would…).

require.label: Utilise le conditionnel (would, could) au moins 5 fois
Utilise if + prétérit (If I were…, If every street had…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
If I Were Mayor for a Week

If I were the mayor of Gatineau for a week, I would make three big changes. Some people might laugh at my ideas, but I think they would make our city a happier place.

First, I would turn one street downtown into a pedestrian zone every Sunday. Families could walk, cycle and eat outside without worrying about cars. If the weather were nice, we would also organize free concerts there.

Second, I would build more skating rinks in the parks. If every neighbourhood had its own rink, kids would spend less time on screens in winter. Third, I would open the libraries until midnight on Fridays. Imagine board games, movies and hot chocolate surrounded by books!

Of course, these ideas would cost money. But if I were mayor, I would ask the citizens to vote on them first.

prompts.title: De l'arbre à la crêpe
prompts.prompt: Le journal de l'école demande un article sur un produit de chez nous : comment il est fabriqué, où il est produit, par qui. Exemple : le sirop d'érable, le fromage, le pain… Utilise la voix passive (is collected, was invented by…).

require.label: Utilise la voix passive au moins 5 fois (is made, are collected…)
Utilise by pour dire qui fait l'action
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
From Tree to Pancake

Maple syrup is loved by millions of Canadians, but do you know how it is made? Most of the world's maple syrup is produced in Quebec, and the basic idea has not changed in centuries.

The sap is collected in early spring, when the nights are still freezing but the days are warmer. Small holes are drilled into maple trees, and the sap is carried through plastic tubes to a sugar shack. There, it is boiled for hours until most of the water disappears. About forty litres of sap are needed to make just one litre of syrup! Finally, the syrup is filtered and poured into bottles or cans.

Maple sugar was first made by Indigenous peoples long before Europeans arrived. Today, the tradition is celebrated every spring, when families visit sugar shacks to eat pancakes and maple taffy on snow.

prompts.title: Le métier de mes rêves
prompts.prompt: Pour l'orientation scolaire, décris le métier de tes rêves : une personne qui…, un endroit où…, le moment où…, quelqu'un dont… Utilise des pronoms relatifs (who, which, where, whose, when).

require.label: Au moins 5 pronoms relatifs différents (who, which, that, where, whose, when)
Termine avec une phrase au conditionnel (If I became…, I would…)
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
My Dream Job: Wildlife Vet

A wildlife vet is a doctor who takes care of wild animals. It's the job that I've wanted to do since I was eight, when I found an injured owl in my grandparents' backyard.

Wildlife vets work in places where animals need help: rescue centres, national parks and sometimes zoos. They treat animals which have been hurt by cars, fences or pollution. The best part of the job is the day when a healthy animal returns to the wild. My aunt, whose friend works at a rescue centre near Montreal, says it's the most rewarding moment of all.

Of course, it isn't an easy job. You need to study for many years, and the animals that you treat can bite or scratch! But if I became a wildlife vet, I would be the happiest person in the world.

prompts.title: Si seulement…
prompts.prompt: Ton ami(e) te demande de tes nouvelles. Réponds-lui en te plaignant gentiment de ton quotidien (trajets, voisins, travail) avec I wish… + prétérit, et imagine ce que tu ferais si les choses étaient différentes.

require.label: Utilise I wish + prétérit (I wish I had…)
Utilise le conditionnel (would) au moins 3 fois
Organise ton texte en au moins 3 paragraphes

prompts.model:
Hi Malik,

Thanks for your message! You asked how I'm doing, so here is my honest answer: I'm surviving, but only just.

I wish my office weren't so far from home. Every morning, I spend an hour and a half on two buses, and they are always packed. If I had a car, I would save so much time, but parking downtown costs a fortune. I also wish my upstairs neighbours didn't practise the drums at eleven o'clock at night! If they were quieter, I would sleep much better and I wouldn't be so grumpy at work.

Most of all, I wish you still lived in Toronto. If you were here, we would go for our Sunday brunch like in the old days. Any chance you could visit this summer?

Take care,
Sofia

prompts.title: La pire préparation du monde
prompts.prompt: Raconte une journée où tu as voulu « faire faire » plein de choses avant un grand événement (I had my hair cut, I got my bike repaired…) et où rien ne s'est passé comme prévu. Utilise aussi au moins un pronom réfléchi (myself, herself…).

require.label: Utilise have / get something done au moins 2 fois (I had my hair cut…)
Un pronom réfléchi (myself, themselves…)
